results.title: In the Shadows, We Lose the Sense of Colour
results.original_title: V šere sa stráca cit pre farby
results.overview: Katka was thirteen. Roman was forty. The summer camp Chachaland, once a place of joy for children, became a place of abuse. What followed were years of therapy, depression, and PTSD. As an adult, Katka found the strength to write a blog and take her abuser to court.The film is an intimate testimony to how abuse continues to shape a life long after it ends – and how the courage to speak out can be both deeply painful and profoundly healing.

results.title: Last Generation
results.overview: Lucas, a baby desperate for his parents' attention, finally finds the solution: his mother’s mobile phone. Little does he know that by getting what he so desired, he will open the door to a future no one could have foreseen.

results.title: Primer amor
results.overview: Manolo is a young “barra brava”—a fan of the Deportivo Cali soccer club—who must flee the city with Camila, his pregnant girlfriend, after getting involved in a fight between rival fan groups. Manolo and Camila arrive at his grandfather’s house in the middle of the countryside, where they must adjust to a different way of life as the pregnancy progresses and the soccer season unfolds. When Deportivo Cali makes it to the final, Manolo is faced with the decision of whether to travel to the stadium to watch the game and follow his passion for the team or to be present for the birth of his child—a difficult choice for a passionate fan.

results.title: 10 Days till Halloween

results.title: Murder In Melbourne
results.overview: When Amarjeet Singh disappears after sending his wife Simran a cryptic message, Detective Shergil investigates. His search uncovers family secrets, illicit affairs, betrayal and a property dispute. When Amarjeet's body is found and Simran vanishes, the case turns darker. As suspects die and clues lead in different directions, Shergil must confront his past to catch the killer.

results.title: The Rug
results.overview: Hamed, a hardworking rug cleaner in Tehran, faces a dilemma after discovering that one of the expensive Persian rugs he picked up for cleaning is missing. Desperate to find it and avoid the hefty cost of replacement, he retraces his steps, growing increasingly suspicious of his friends who handled the order the previous evening.

results.title: Dinner with Michelle

results.title: Pimpin ‘  Ain’t Eazy
results.overview: In Oakland, a former abuse survivor turned female pimp runs her male escort business with her mentor's guidance. When a jobless man accidentally enters their world, he must adapt to an unexpected new life.

results.title: Fetch! The Reboot: The No-Phone Amazing Race
results.original_title: Fetch! The Reboot: The No-Phone Amazing Race
results.overview: "Greetings, my loyal fans! It is I, Ruff Ruffman—animated host extraordinaire, now tragically stuck in low-budget 2D—and I am BACK for an extra-special, definitely-not-a-desperate-one-time-thing reboot of FETCH! This time for all you adults out there!  I’ve dragged former FETCHer Shreya and GBH Intern Holly away from their precious smartphones to navigate the perilous streets of Boston and NYC completely offline, guided only by physical maps, raw instinct, and GBH transportation guru Jeremy Siegel. Watch now—because your views are literally the only thing keeping my boss from canceling me again, and if this works, we're bringing the show back for real... and taking over grown-up television!"

results.title: Twenty One Pilots: Electric Castle 2026
results.overview: Twenty One Pilots taking over Electric Castle’s Main Stage with an unforgettable show, bringing thousands of fans together for one of EC12’s biggest moments.

results.title: The Rupture
results.overview: When a daycare refuses to let her children inside, Olivia, a single mother in Tijuana, is pushed into a relentless race across the city, where time, money and options quickly disappear.
